name: @ezclassify/rest-client
description: Thin TypeScript client for EzClassify REST deployments
author: EzClassify, LLC

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-spec-version.mjs && node scripts/generate-response-shapes.mjs && vite build
scripts.deps:relock: node -e "const{rmSync}=require('node:fs');for(const path of ['node_modules','package-lock.json'])rmSync(path,{force:true,recursive:true})" && node scripts/relock.mjs --strip && npm install --package-lock-only --include=optional --ignore-scripts --before="$(node -e 'console.log(new Date(Date.now()-7*864e5).toISOString())')" && node scripts/relock.mjs --restore && npm install --package-lock-only --include=optional --ignore-scripts --tag=dev && node scripts/relock.mjs --normalize && npm run check:lockfile-portable && npm run check:dependency-age
scripts.test: node scripts/generate-spec-version.mjs && node scripts/generate-response-shapes.mjs && vitest run
scripts.test:conformance-server: node scripts/generate-spec-version.mjs && node scripts/generate-response-shapes.mjs && vitest run --config vitest.integration.mjs
scripts.test:verbose: node scripts/generate-spec-version.mjs && node scripts/generate-response-shapes.mjs && vitest run --reporter=verbose --no-file-parallelism
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/generate-spec-version.mjs && node scripts/generate-response-shapes.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.contract.json
scripts.verify:publish-ready: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm pack --dry-run
